dex.text: Stands very still in the reeds, pretending very hard to be a stick. Only gives itself away when it starts to boom.
dex.fact: Bitterns stand with their bills pointing straight up to look like reeds, which makes them very hard to spot.

dex.text: Has a voice like a foghorn with a grudge, and a habit of turning up where nobody expects. Prefers the wetlands and would like you to know it was there first.
dex.fact: The bittern's booming call can be heard from kilometres away, even though the bird itself is hard to see.
